messages:
olivia: quick RN + internal announce copy for v2.6-lite rollout. need a pin owner and a rollback watcher. plan below.

olivia: RN draft:
• What: v2.6-lite-quant updated quant path with micro-ops to lower tail latency and reduce memory for batchy workloads (~12% avg uplift)
• Fix: addresses occasional streaming stalls and reduces cold-start penalty for KV cache
• Compat: Dedicated customers will fall back to pinned v2.5 if capacity constrained

olivia: rollout plan: canary 4% -> 25% after 18m -> 75% after 50m -> 100% after 2h. rollback gates: error rate >2x baseline for 3m OR p95 latency >700ms for 10m. enable debug logs for first 20m and keep sample-rate 1s.

emma: copy nit: internal snippet should say "ops monitoring; will update" instead of "ops will monitor". also please add a note to ping #customer-ops on rollback.

ryan: i can own model pin + kickoff. proposed pin id: model-redwood/v2.6-lite-q1 pinned to inference-v2.6. lgtm.

olivia: updated. internal blurb suggestion: \"Heads up: v2.6-lite rolling at 10:00 UTC \"Ops monitoring; will update.\"

ryan: scheduling deploy at 2025-09-10T10:00:00Z. deploy-bot params below.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy created by @ryan. job id: db-2170005555. commands:
```
deploy-bot run db-2170005555 --stage canary --percent 4 --wait 1080 --debug-logs true
deploy-bot promote db-2170005555 --percent 25 --wait 3240 --dns-hold 300 --sample-rate 1s
deploy-bot promote db-2170005555 --percent 75 --wait 3600 --fallback-delay 600
deploy-bot promote db-2170005555 --percent 100
deploy-bot rollback db-2170005555 --reason \"rollback gate triggered\"
```

emma: i'll post internal snippet at T-10 and stand by for quick edits. i'll also prep the customer-ops alert template and link it to the rollback playbook.

olivia: final checklist: RN saved, internal snippet ready, model pin model-redwood/v2.6-lite-q1, deploy job scheduled & queued, rollback watch assigned to ryan, sample-rate and dns-hold flags set. go/no-go check at 09:40 UTC.

deploy-bot: job db-2170005555 created and moved to queued state by @ryan.
